name: ariadne
description: Standalone lifecycle control with cross-Skill dependency scanning and isolated-install assurance for self-authored Codex Skills.

interface.shortDescription: Keep Skill development, formal, and release versions separate
interface.longDescription: Rejects cross-Skill dependencies, verifies exact Plugins in isolated profiles, enforces develop/main boundaries, creates deterministic formal artifacts, and prevents release drift.
defaultPrompt: Use $ariadne to classify and control this Skill change.
Use $ariadne to run a formal promotion dry-run.
Use $ariadne to verify a Skill release or rollback.
